Smartsheet automation email not working: what to check

Most Smartsheet emails that do not arrive come down to a few causes. Here they are in the order worth checking, plus what these emails can hold.

Checked 2026-11-21. Menus in other products change, so a label may differ slightly on your screen.

Short answer: most of the time the email was sent but the recipient's mail system blocked or filtered it, or it went only to the person who made the change, and Smartsheet does not email that person. Check spam first, then ask IT to allow Smartsheet's sending domains. Also check that the person who made the change is not the only recipient, that nobody unsubscribed, and that your sender profile has a name.

First, find out which kind of problem you have

Smartsheet's help center splits this into two cases: the email was sent but never reached the inbox, or it was never sent. Ask the recipient to look at the bell icon inside Smartsheet. If the notice is there, the workflow ran and the problem is on the email side. If it is not there, look at the workflow itself.

The causes, most common first

1. The recipient's mail system filtered or blocked it

Check spam, junk and any quarantine folder. Company filters such as Mimecast or Proofpoint often hold mail from senders they have not seen before. Ask whoever runs your email to release the message and allow Smartsheet. For a standard US account, Smartsheet's help page lists these domains: smartsheet.com, app.smartsheet.com, info.smartsheet.com, system.smartsheet.com, reply.smartsheet.com and bounce.smartsheet.com, plus noreply@smartsheet.com. EU accounts use smartsheet.eu domains and Australian accounts use smartsheet.au domains, so check the help page for yours. Australian accounts also need mail.application.smartsheet.au, which Smartsheet says is the one for automation emails. Here is wording for IT:

Hello [IT contact name], Some automated emails from Smartsheet are not reaching [recipient name]. Could you check the spam and quarantine filters for messages from Smartsheet, release any you find, and allow these sending domains: smartsheet.com, app.smartsheet.com, info.smartsheet.com, system.smartsheet.com, reply.smartsheet.com and bounce.smartsheet.com, plus noreply@smartsheet.com? The sender address on the workflow emails is automation@app.smartsheet.com. The last one that did not arrive was sent on [date]. Thank you, [your name]

2. The person who made the change is not emailed

Smartsheet does not send an alert to the person who triggered the workflow. If you test by editing a row and you are the only recipient, you will never see it. Test with a second person, or have a coworker make the change.

3. The recipient unsubscribed

Every alert has an unsubscribe link. Using it stops that person getting alerts from that one workflow only. Smartsheet staff in the community forum say the person can turn it back on from Manage Alerts and Actions on the sheet, or you can copy the workflow. Smartsheet does not show you who unsubscribed; support can sometimes tell you.

4. Your profile name is blank

Smartsheet's help page says that if the First and Last Name in your Personal Settings are empty, filters may flag the email, because the sender shows only an address. Open your account icon, then Personal Settings, fill in both names, then ask IT to recheck.

5. A second automation moved the row first

If one workflow moves or copies the row on the same trigger as your alert, the alert can fail because the row is already gone. Community answers suggest triggering the move from a separate checkbox column that is ticked after the alert. Smartsheet does not document this, and one user said it did not fully fix it. Avoid two workflows reacting to the same change.

6. Permissions or sharing

Smartsheet has an automation permission setting on each sheet, found under Automation, then Manage automation workflows, then the gear icon. There are three levels. Restricted is the default and reaches only people who can view the sheet and have logged in to Smartsheet. Limited also reaches people in your Smartsheet account. Unrestricted lets anyone get notifications, even if the sheet is not shared with them. A sheet can match your account-wide setting or be stricter, but not looser. Email contacts who are not added as users are skipped under Restricted and Limited. To fix it, share the sheet with the person, add them as a user, or ask your Smartsheet system admin to loosen the setting. Also confirm a sheet ownership transfer was completed, not just started.

7. The trigger conditions are not met

Check that the workflow is turned on, that the trigger matches what you changed, and that a condition is not filtering the row out. Time-based reminders only fire at the set time.

8. Plan limits and outages

Smartsheet limits automated workflows and notifications by plan, including a daily notification limit. Those counts include other notices too, such as @mentions and sharing emails. Smartsheet does not publish the current numbers on its help pages, so ask Smartsheet support or your account owner. Also check Smartsheet's status page, since delays happen. Emails over 20 MB are not sent and show no error, which mostly affects sending a sheet as an attachment.

If none of this helps, contact Smartsheet Support with the workflow ID (under the automation's Properties), the sheet name and the recipient's address.

What Smartsheet's automated emails can and cannot contain

Formatting

The message is plain text you type in a box limited to 2,000 characters. You can drop in row values with the column name in double braces, such as {{Task Name}}. Smartsheet's help page describes no other formatting options, and community threads show people asking for bold, colors and layout without success. The email also comes from Smartsheet's own address (automation@app.smartsheet.com), with the reply going to the person who triggered it. Depending on setup, the From name may be the triggering user, the sheet owner or your organization. For when the message is wrong for customers, see Can Smartsheet send automated emails?

Which columns

Under "Message includes" you can choose links to the sheet with all fields, links to the sheet with specific fields, or message only. If you pick specific fields, only those go in. If an alert goes to someone outside your account, links may be stripped and replaced with "[External link removed]".

Attachments

Time-based alerts and reminders carry no attachments or comments. Change-based alerts include only attachments added at the moment of the trigger, not ones already on the row. Update requests and approval requests include all attachments and comments, old and new. So to send a file, use an update request, or add the file in the same change that fires the alert.

Many rows at once

When six or fewer rows trigger at the same time, each gets its own email. At seven or more, the custom subject and body are removed. Time-based reminders for several rows are grouped into one email.
